Welcome to BowlingMagic!
YOUR ROLL
🖱️ Left-click sets your shot · Right-click goes back to adjustAnother Free & Fun Experience From • TagMagic Studio
How many bowlers?
How many people bowling?
Pick 1 to 3 computer bowlers to take on
1. Spot – slide your mouse left or right to choose where you stand, then click.
2. Aim – move your mouse to put the pink target on the lane arrows, then click.
3. Release – click when the swinging needle is in the green. Early pulls the ball left, late pushes it right.
Your roll – pick Straight, Hook Left or Hook Right at the bottom left anytime before you roll.
Hit the pocket (just beside the head pin) for strikes. Right-click while aiming to go back to your spot.
Skill – Easy: big green zone, slow needle, full path shown. Medium: smaller green zone, a bit faster. Hard: small green zone, fast needle, path only to the arrows. Pro: tiny green zone, fastest needle, no aim line at all. On Hard and Pro, the lane changes as the oil wears down.
Keyboard works too: ← → to move, Space to click.
Sounds from Freesound.org by tomlija, sieuamthanh, mrrockcandy, driftworks, kyles & moviebuffgavin
